verdict.rationale: A business-entity registry and filing service could plausibly offer event-triggered automation, such as auto-filing, auto-payment, or status-change triggers, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only manual workflows: PDF forms submitted by upload, fax or mail, and a CAPTCHA-gated annual report portal. Nothing documents user-defined rules or actions that fire automatically on events, and probes found no API or OpenAPI spec.
